tools.name: search
tools.description: Find animals, animal groups, trip types, national parks, countries and regions on Wallace's Line by name (English; common Spanish names work too). Returns ids to pass to fetch.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Get the sighting figures behind an id returned by search (an animal: where to see it; a park: its easiest animals; a place: its iconic animals).

tools.name: species_where
tools.description: Best national parks to see an animal or animal group (e.g. "jaguar", "Panthera onca", "bears", "whales"), ranked by the daily chance of seeing it; optionally in one month and/or one country or region.

tools.name: park_species
tools.description: The animals you are most likely to see in a national park (daily probability), optionally in one month.

tools.name: iconic
tools.description: The iconic animals of a country or continent with the park where each is easiest to see, and the best-rated parks there.

tools.name: plan_trip
tools.description: A day-by-day route of parks for a trip of N days in one or more countries, maximising the chance of seeing the animals asked for (or the country's iconic animals), with travel legs. Same engine as the site's trip planner.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
